raw.rationale: Nilutamide is an androgen receptor antagonist whose antiproliferative activity is largely restricted to AR-dependent prostate cancer, and at 2.5 µM for 5 days it is unlikely to selectively kill most non-prostate lineages; modest AR expression in breast and some urinary tract lines could produce rare weak selective effects. Thus probabilities are low across all listed non-prostate lineages, with breast and urinary_tract slightly higher than the rest.
